tool.name: pmotools combine_pmos
tool.description: Combine multiple PMO files from the same panel into one

param.name: input_pmos
param.label: PMO files to combine
param.help: Select two or more PMO files from the same amplicon panel

tool.help:
@HELP_PREAMBLE@
**Combine PMOs**
Combines multiple PMO files from the same amplicon panel into a single PMO file. All input PMOs must be from the same panel.
**Input**
- Two or more PMO JSON files (optionally gzipped) from the same amplicon panel
**Output**
- A single combined PMO JSON file
